items.headline: Heat Advisory issued August 22 at 4:48AM CDT until August 23 at 7:00PM CDT by NWS Austin/San Antonio TX
items.label: Alert
items.detail:
* WHAT...Temperatures up to 105 and heat index values up to 111
expected.

* WHERE...I-35 Corridor, Coastal Plains, and across Burnet/Llano
Counties in the Hill Country.

* WHEN...Until 7 PM CDT Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Hot temperatures and high humidity may cause heat
illnesses.
